content.subject: Where to file? Comparing two states on product defect law
content.body:
Hi,

As you know, my injury from the kitchen appliance happened while I was visiting family across the state line, but I live and work back home. We talked briefly about whether it would be better strategically to file here at home or in the neighboring state where the incident occurred, and I've been thinking about it more.

Before we make that call, could you put together a written comparison of how the two states handle product defect claims? What I'd find most useful is a side-by-side that walks through the leading cases in each state on the core product defect theories, with the citations of those leading decisions included so I can actually look at them. I'd want to see how each jurisdiction frames manufacturing defects, design defects, and failure-to-warn claims, and also how each one handles things like the statute of limitations and any caps on damages, again with the controlling authority cited.

I know this is a research-heavy ask and I'm fine paying for the time. I'd just rather make a forum decision based on actual law than on a gut feel, and having the cases pulled together in one document I can study would give me a lot more confidence going into our next strategy meeting.

Thanks so much,
Renata
